record.original_question: Let G be a connected graph. Must min{s+(G), s-(G)} always be at least n - 1, where s+(G) and s-(G) are the sums of the squares of the positive and negative adjacency eigenvalues of G and n is the number of vertices? More strongly, for an arbitrary graph with k connected components, must min{s+(G), s-(G)} be at least n - k?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 1 (Elphick-Farber-Goldberg-Wocjan [54]). Let G be a connected graph. Then min{s+(G), s-(G)} ≥ n − 1.
In fact, the above conjecture has a stronger form that every graph with κ components satisfies that min{s+(G), s-(G)} ≥ n − κ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with adjacency matrix $A(G)$. Let $\lambda_1 \geq \lambda_2 \geq \cdots \geq \lambda_n$ be the eigenvalues of $A(G)$. Define
$$s^+(G) = \sum_{\lambda_i > 0} \lambda_i^2, \qquad s^-(G) = \sum_{\lambda_i < 0} \lambda_i^2.$$

(a) Prove or disprove: if $G$ is connected, then
$$\min\{s^+(G),\, s^-(G)\} \;\geq\; n - 1.$$

(b) (Stronger form.) Prove or disprove: if $G$ is an arbitrary graph having exactly $\kappa$ connected components, then
$$\min\{s^+(G),\, s^-(G)\} \;\geq\; n - \kappa.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open in general. It has been verified for several graph classes (bipartite, regular, complete multipartite, line/claw-free graphs, graphs with small order after blow-up). Recent partial progress includes Shengtong Zhang's 2024 result establishing $\min\{s^+(G), s^-(G)\} \geq n - \gamma(G) \geq n/2$ (where $\gamma$ is the domination number), and a 2025 preprint resolving the claw-free case via a "gluing lemma". No counterexamples are known and no proof of the full conjecture has appeared.

status_evidence.title: Extremal values for the square energies of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Proves min(s+(G), s-(G)) ≥ n - γ ≥ n/2, verifying the Elphick-Farber-Goldberg-Wocjan conjecture up to a constant.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: linear lower bound n/2 established, full conjecture still open.

status_evidence.title: Refinement of a conjecture on positive square energy of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture for claw-free graphs (and hence line graphs) using a new Gluing lemma.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for additional graph classes (claw-free), but general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Conjectured bounds for the sum of squares of positive eigenvalues of a graph
status_evidence.snippet: Original conjecture by Elphick, Farber, Goldberg, Wocjan with verification for several graph classes.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture stated and verified for bipartite, regular, complete multipartite graphs, etc.
